intro: Incendia Powder is an enchanted ritual catalyst refined to ignite sacred flames. Carried by Horde emissaries into Thousand Needles, the powder is specifically treated with shamanic incantations to invoke the slumbering spirit-beast Arikara atop Darkcloud Pinnacle.

p: Incendia Powder is no mundane explosive or mundane flash powder; it is a purified, ritualistic substance carefully infused with shamanic magic. Enchanted and entrusted to travelers by Magatha Grimtotem on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise, the mixture is designed to react solely with the sacred fire of life burning atop the isolated spires of Darkcloud Pinnacle. Once scattered across the consecrated brazier where the dead are laid to rest, its alchemical and spiritual warding calls forth the vengeful winged serpent Arikara.
